display.name: Airtable
display.blurb: Read and write Airtable base records and inspect base schema — authenticated with a personal access token brokered at the egress proxy, never seen by the agent.

cli.doc:
Use `airtable` to read and write Airtable data from this session. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects the personal access token on requests to api.airtable.com; `AIRTABLE_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT set a real token or run any login.

Base id (e.g. `appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX`) and table name/id (e.g. `Tasks` or `tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX`) are NON-secret arguments you pass on the command line. The PAT is scoped to specific bases/workspaces at creation — only those are reachable.

Discover what you can reach:
  airtable whoami                              Token owner + scopes (requires no extra power)
  airtable bases                               List accessible bases (requires `bases:read`)
  airtable schema <baseId>                     List tables/fields/views in a base (requires `schema:read`)

Records:
  airtable list <baseId> <table> [field=value ...]   List records, paginated; pass e.g. maxRecords=10, view=Grid, filterByFormula=... (requires `records:read`)
  airtable get <baseId> <table> <recordId>           Fetch one record (requires `records:read`)
  airtable create <baseId> <table> '<json>'          Create records; <json> is a body like {"records":[{"fields":{...}}]} (requires `records:write`)
  airtable update <baseId> <table> '<json>'          PATCH records (partial update); body {"records":[{"id":"rec...","fields":{...}}]} (requires `records:write`)
  airtable delete <baseId> <table> <recordId>        Delete one record (requires `records:write`)

Comments:
  airtable comments <baseId> <table> <recordId>          List a record's comments (requires `comments:read`)
  airtable comment <baseId> <table> <recordId> <text>    Add a comment (requires `comments:write`)

Escape hatches (the path is appended to https://api.airtable.com/v0):
  airtable get-raw <path>                  GET an arbitrary /v0 path (e.g. airtable get-raw /meta/whoami)
  airtable api <METHOD> <path> ['<json>']  Any method; JSON body sent as application/json

Responses are JSON. Airtable returns 200 on success and {"error":{...}} with a 4xx on failure (e.g. 422 for invalid fields, 403 for a base the token can't reach).
